name: Art History
notes: Ten courses. Students shape the major around a region, period, theme, or conceptual framework with a department advisor.
AHST 100 and AHST 101 are named as the two introductory courses that best frame the major, but the requirement is any three 100-level courses in the program.
One of the four 200/400-level program courses may be an independent study or internship.
Honors requires a 3.5 GPA within the major - not modeled.
